name: Nightly Build Size Check

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 2 AM UTC every Monday
    - cron: '0 2 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

env:
  # Configuration is now centralized in .github/nightly-build-config.yml
  # These are fallback values if the config file is not found
  MAVEN_FULL_BUILD_PROJECTS: "\\!debezium-microbenchmark-oracle"
  SIZE_THRESHOLD_PERCENTAGE: 70
  SIZE_BASE_GB: 1

jobs:

  # Gate the whole workflow so it only runs on the upstream repository, never on forks.
  # Every build job depends on this, so on a fork all jobs are skipped instead of run.
  guard:
    name: Guard (upstream only)
    if: github.repository == 'debezium/debezium'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Confirm upstream repository
        run: echo "Running on ${{ github.repository }}"

  build_cassandra:
    name: Cassandra
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: guard
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Action (Core)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          path: core
      - name: Checkout Action (Cassandra)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: debezium/debezium-connector-cassandra
          path: cassandra
          ref: main
      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/setup-java
      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/maven-cache
        with:
          key: maven-debezium-test-push-build-${{ hashFiles('core/**/pom.xml') }}
      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/build-debezium-cassandra
        with:
          path-core: core
          path-cassandra: cassandra
          only-build: 'true'
      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: cassandra-build
          path: |
            cassandra/**/*.jar
            cassandra/**/*.tar.gz
            cassandra/**/*.zip
          retention-days: 1

  build_db2:
    name: Db2
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: guard
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Action (Core)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

          repository: debezium/debezium-connector-db2

      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/setup-java
      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/maven-cache
        with:
          key: maven-debezium-test-push-build-${{ hashFiles('core/**/pom.xml') }}
      - uses: ./core/.github/actions/build-debezium-db2
        with:
          path-core: core
          path-db2: db2
          only-build: 'true'
      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: db2-build
          path: |
            db2/**/*.jar
            db2/**/*.tar.gz
            db2/**/*.zip
          retention-days: 1

  build_ibmi:
    name: IBMi
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: guard

      - name: Checkout Action (Core)
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
